Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/7] Fig. 2 shows the relationship between age and SWB using all observations and a model fit with 95% credible interval for group-level data based on the probit transformed, polynomial, no lag, random error model. Group-level model fits show that SWB generally fluctuated between about 0.2 or 0.3 either side of 7.5.
